release_notes:
Fix deferred order emails/SMS silently dropped; restore admin mobile language selector

Async regression (1.0.32): marking an IMEI order complete/cancelled/
resubmitted defers the customer email + SMS + push to a shutdown handler
(gf_run_deferred_tasks) so the admin action returns immediately. But
footer.php closes $objDBCD14 at end of the page — before the shutdown
handler runs — so every query inside the deferred email/SMS/push work
hit a dead mysqli connection and failed silently (swallowed by the
handler's try/catch). Customers got no notification.

Fix: the deferred handler now opens its own dedicated CD14DB connection
and passes it to each task; code.php's closure takes $objDBCD14 as a
parameter instead of capturing the request's (soon-closed) handle. The
deferred work always has a live connection regardless of footer timing
or SAPI.

Language selector: the admin top-nav language dropdown was
hidden-sm hidden-xs, so it vanished on tablet/phone. Removed the hidden
classes, gave it a gf-lang-li class styled like the user dropdown
(display:flex, stays in the top nav on all sizes; flag-only on phones),
matching the client dashboard which keeps its language picker on mobile.
